item.title: Welcome to Bob's SKA Radio
item.description: The website is moving to a new host and may look a little different but everything should work the same. No changes to the streaming and any saved bookmarks will be the same. Streaming live 24/7 since 2008 to Europe, Asia, North/South/Central America, Africa and world wide. Now streaming 128K AAC for near CD quality, with over 21,000 songs and 9500+ lossless audio files in the library.
